name: k8s-deployment-readiness
description: Three-gate Kubernetes deployment readiness workflow (develop / staging|uat / production) derived from learnkube.com/production-best-practices. Verifies application code, manifests, Terraform, and GitOps repos against the full checklist; deeply instrumented for OpenTelemetry, RED/USE metrics, exemplars, and multi-burn-rate SLO alerting. Two specialized subagents (deployment-verifier, observability-auditor) load six internal skills that are not user-invocable.
